question.knowledge_point: Calculating the Cross Product Using Determinants
question.worked_solution:
Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 4 & 5 & -1 \\ -6 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}5 & -1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ -6 & 2\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}4 & 5 \\ -6 & 0\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(5\cdot 2-(-1)\cdot 0)i-(4\cdot 2-(-1)\cdot (-6))j+(4\cdot 0-5\cdot (-6))k \\  & =(10-0)i-(8-6)j+(0-(-30))k \\  & =10i-2j+30k.\end{aligned}
$$
